careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and maintains software applications and systems. Works across frontend, backend, or full-stack development.

context.education: BS Computer Science or related; bootcamp acceptable for entry
context.careerPath: Junior Dev  to  Mid-level Dev  to  Senior Dev  to  Staff/Principal Engineer
context.discoveryHint: If you love building things and solving logic puzzles, this is the path.

careers.title: Registered Nurse
careers.description: Provides direct patient care, administers medications, and monitors health conditions in hospitals, clinics, and other settings.

context.education: BSN (Bachelor of Science in Nursing); RN licensure exam required
context.careerPath: RN Bedside Nurse  to  Charge Nurse  to  Nurse Manager  to  Nursing Leadership
context.discoveryHint: Make a direct difference in people's health and well-being every day.

careers.title: High School Teacher
careers.description: Educates students in specific subject areas, develops curriculum, and assesses student learning.

context.education: BA in subject area + teaching credential/MAT
context.jobOutlook: 4% growth, moderate demand with regional variation
context.careerPath: New Teacher  to  Experienced Teacher  to  Department Chair  to  Administration
context.discoveryHint: Shape young minds and inspire the next generation in your field of expertise.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Analyzes complex datasets to extract insights and build predictive models for business decisions.

context.education: BS Math/Statistics/CS or MS Data Science
context.careerPath: Junior Data Scientist  to  Data Scientist  to  Senior Data Scientist  to  ML Lead
context.discoveryHint: Turn raw data into actionable insights that drive real business impact.

careers.title: Civil Engineer

context.education: BS Civil Engineering + PE license
context.careerPath: Junior Engineer  to  Civil Engineer  to  Senior Engineer  to  Project Manager

careers.title: Physician (MD/DO)
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats diseases, performs surgeries, and manages patient health across medical specialties.

context.careerPath: Resident  to  Board-Certified Physician  to  Specialist  to  Division Chief
context.discoveryHint: Dedicate your career to healing and improving human health at the highest level.

careers.title: Marketing Manager

context.education: BA Marketing, Business, or Communications
context.careerPath: Assistant Manager  to  Marketing Manager  to  Senior Manager  to  Director

careers.title: Certified Public Accountant (CPA)

careers.title: Environmental Scientist

careers.title: Graphic Designer
